meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按 Dieter Rams 十项原则逐条审计一个设计,给每项打 0–3 分并附证据,判定结论(NEW / REFINE / REDESIGN),最后产出一份可直接粘贴的 /make-plan 提示。它不写实现代码。
howto.when: 当你提到「审计这个设计」、「设计评审」、「这 UI 好不好」等说法,或想要一份能接着生成计划的设计评审时接管。

say.text: 审计这个设计,按拉姆斯十项原则打分出结论
say.note: 产出打分卡、结论与 /make-plan 交接提示

say.text: 检查这个 UI 的对比度、焦点环和空状态
say.note: 归入视觉与细节原则的证据收集

say.text: 把这次审计结论变成一份 /make-plan 提示
say.note: 按 NEW / REFINE / REDESIGN 模板生成

howto.what_en: Claude audits a design against Dieter Rams' ten principles, scores each 0–3 with cited evidence, picks a verdict (NEW / REFINE / REDESIGN), and hands off a copy-pasteable /make-plan prompt. It writes no implementation code.
howto.when_en: Use when you say "audit this design", "design review", "is this UI good" and similar, or want a critique that leads to a plan.

say_en.text: Audit this design against the ten Rams principles
Check this UI's contrast, focus rings and empty states
say_en.note: Feeds visual and detail evidence gathering

say_en.text: Turn this audit verdict into a /make-plan prompt
say_en.note: Uses the NEW / REFINE / REDESIGN template
